descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Pastel' Light Pink Pastel Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Pastel' leafs out in the spring with a pastel pink reticulated variegation. As the season progresses, the veins in the leaf become darker creating a more dramatic effect. 'Pastel' turns to a bright red to deep maroon in the fall. 'Pastel' is a newer selection recently introduced by Talon Buchholz. 'Pastel' is expected to reach 10 ft in height in 10 years. Protection from the hot afternoon sun is recommended for best pastel colors. The photo(s) with a MrMaple logo are owned by MrMaple.com and cannot be used without expressed written consent. The photos on this page without a MrMaple logo were taken by Talon Buchholz and cannot be used without expressed written consent from the owner.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Pastel'，浅粉色网脉斑锦日本枫，适生区 5-9。‘Pastel’ 春季展叶时带有粉彩般的浅粉色网脉斑锦。随着生长季推进，叶脉颜色逐渐加深，形成更强烈的观赏对比。秋季转为鲜红至深栗红色。‘Pastel’ 是 Talon Buchholz 近年推出的较新选育品种，预计 10 年可长至高 10 英尺。为获得最佳粉彩色表现，建议避开炎热的午后强光。带有 MrMaple 标识的照片归 MrMaple.com 所有，未经明确书面许可不得使用。本页无 MrMaple 标识的照片由 Talon Buchholz 拍摄，未经所有者明确书面许可不得使用。数量有限！！由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多。建议您看到心仪品种及时购买，因为部分精选品种常常很快售罄。
